title: Accounts Receivable Note: Bank Return-Item Charge on Respite Stay Returned Payments
content:
A payment returned unpaid on a stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement carries, within its returned-payment fee, a bank return-item charge set by the instrument of the stay's latest payment.

**Charge.** The bank return-item charge follows the instrument of the stay's latest payment: twelve dollars (12.00) for a one-time ACH debit, twenty dollars (20.00) for a credit or debit card, and nothing for any other instrument.

**How it enters the fee.** The bank return-item charge is added to the returned-payment fee as a flat amount.

**Record read.** The instrument shown on the stay's latest payment entry, latest by posting date.

| Instrument of the stay's latest payment | Bank return-item charge |
|---|---|
| One-time ACH debit | 12.00 |
| Credit card | 20.00 |
| Debit card | 20.00 |
| Personal check | Nothing |
| Certified or cashier's check | Nothing |
| Electronic transfer from a long-term care insurer | Nothing |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- The stay's payments are a check in March and a one-time ACH debit in April; the latest payment is the ACH debit: 12.00.
- The stay's only payment is a debit card payment: 20.00.
- The stay's latest payment is an insurer transfer: nothing.
